lead: Bal Thackeray was an Indian politician, born on 23 January 1926 in Pune.
He died on 17 November 2012 in Mumbai at the age of 86.
The sections that follow break down Bal Thackeray's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Bal Thackeray — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Bal Thackeray was born on 23 January 1926 in Pune, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India.
Public records name his father, Keshav Sitaram Thackeray and his mother, Rama-bai Thackeray. He is a sibling of Pama Thackeray Tipnis.
He is recorded as speaking Marathi.

sections.heading: Bal Thackeray — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician, journalist, painter and cartoonist as his occupations.

sections.heading: Bal Thackeray — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He was married to Meena Thackeray.
He is a parent to Uddhav Thackeray, Jaidev Thackeray and Bindumadhav Thackeray.
